carry_forwards_added.disposition: Install a JRE + firebase/gcloud emulator on a8cos when real-Firestore integration testing is needed (pairs with Track B notjustavar provisioning), OR run integration tests on a host that has the tooling. Mock coverage is sufficient for the module logic.
